html: The same KEAP1-NRF2 core laid out four ways, to choose a layout and a flow direction. Human-like (v02, v03): placed by a person's story, the main column from the NFE2L2 gene to NRF2's degradation, the ligase beside it with its three modifications beyond, the escape to the nucleus on the near side; no overlaps, one crossing. Grown (v04, v05): grown from the content by the growing method, each compartment apart, as it cannot yet handle compartments or complexes; the main story grows well, the complexes do not (sensor chemicals on the ligase, arcs through glyphs). Left to right is the top-to-bottom drawing turned.
